title: M3.0 GitHub Pages packaging contradictory QA
purpose: Independently challenge the exact frozen GitHub Pages packaging candidate and its live deployment before the human authoring gate.
invariants: QA changes exactly the three QA-owned paths and never repairs product code.
All ATLAS-WP-009 foundation files remain byte-identical to the independently accepted frozen authoring product HEAD.
ATLAS-WP-010 remains exactly the productHead under test.
The browser adapter delegates semantic authority to the frozen Python core and validators rather than duplicating validation in JavaScript.
No-op live export is byte-identical to the canonical bundled source kit.
For a semantic edit, browser draft lineage/revision behavior is checked and browser export must equal direct frozen Python export of that exact browser draft.

Tampered restored drafts remain visibly blocked: canonical validation reports a blocking integrity diagnostic, export stays disabled, preview cannot bypass integrity checks, and only explicit author discard clears the isolated authoring localStorage namespace.
External browser traffic is restricted to GET-only pinned Pyodide assets and carries no kit/draft payload.
The deployed learner root remains byte-identical to the promoted M2.2 artifact.
Final QA PASS authorizes only the human gate, not product merge or promotion.
requiredEvidence: Exact QA-only three-path diff from productHead.
Exact ATLAS-WP-010 six-path product packaging delta from the frozen M3.0 foundation.
Independent static authority and bundled-sample hash verification.
Live GitHub Pages load with Python engine ready.
Live semantic edit with lineage preserved, package revision rotated and exact-draft export equivalence to the frozen local Python core.
Live tampered-draft fail-closed behavior: blocking diagnostic, export disabled, preview blocked, explicit discard clears only the authoring namespace.
Observed browser external-request allowlist and no authoring-data external POST/body.
Live learner root exact bytes and SHA-256.
Final machine-readable QA artifact bound to exact productHead and QA head.
adversarialTests: Any QA diff outside the three QA-owned paths.
Any product packaging diff outside the six ATLAS-WP-010 paths.
Any frozen ATLAS-WP-009 file changed by packaging.
Bundled sample differs from the read-only canonical proof kit.
No-op live export differs by one byte from source.
Browser export differs from frozen core export of the exact same browser draft.
Lineage changes or required package revision fails to rotate after a semantic edit.
Stale or tampered package revision restores as exportable, lacks a blocking integrity diagnostic, bypasses preview integrity, or cannot be explicitly discarded.
External POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE request, external request body, or external URL outside the pinned Pyodide base.
Live learner root differs in bytes or SHA-256.
Preview claims learner recommendation, memory, transfer or mastery authority.
nonGoals: Approving UX quality on behalf of the human reviewer.
independentReview: QA oracle is independently authored in QA-owned files only.
Product tests may be re-run as corroborating evidence but are not the sole QA basis.
Final verdict binds to one exact frozen productHead and one exact QA head.
The live human gate is exposed only after final contradictory QA passes.
Explicit human PASS remains mandatory before product merge or promotion.
rollback: Close the QA PR without merge. Product and live candidate remain unchanged.
